(const auto& edge : edges) {\n155\t            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n156\t            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n157\t                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n158\t            }\n159\t        }\n160\t    }\n161\t\n162\t    return true;\n163\t}\n164\t\n165\t// ============================================================================\n166\t// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n167\t// ============================================================================\n168\t\n169\tconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\n170\tconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n171\t\n172\tclass Octree {\n173\tpublic:\n174\t    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n175\t    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n176\t    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n177\t    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178\t    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179\t\n180\t    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194\t                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195\t                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196\t                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n    printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Simulation\n    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    runSimulation(state);\n\n    auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();\n\n    printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Distance computation\n    auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeDistances(state);\n\n    auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto distDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist - startDist).count();\n\n    printf(\"Distance computation time: %ld ms\\n\", distDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Total time\n    long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;\n    printf(\"Total computation time: %ld ms\\n\", totalTime);\n\n    // Performance metrics\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n    double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n * n);\n    double simOps = static_cast<double>(n * n * t);\n    double distOps = static_cast<double>(n * t * t);\n\n    printf(\"\\nPerformance:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Triangles: %zu\\n\", n);\n    printf(\"  Timesteps: %zu\\n\", t);\n    printf(\"  Form factor computations: %.2e\\n\", kijOps);\n    printf(\"  Simulation operations: %.2e\\n\", simOps);\n    printf(\"  Distance computations: %.2e\\n\", distOps);\n    printf(\"  Total time per triangle: %.4f MT_MATRIX : 0u);\n}\n\n// Converts a raw mt19937 output to the float produced by\n// uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) (libstdc++ generate_canonical)\n__device__ __forceinline__ float mtTemperToFloat(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= (y >> 11);\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= (y >> 18);\n    float r = __fmul_rn(__uint2float_rn(y), 2.3283064365386963e-10f);  // / 2^32 (exact)\n    if (r >= 1.0f) r = __uint_as_float(0x3f7fffffu);                     // nextafter(1, 0)\n    return r;\n}\n\n// Generates numGens consecutive mt19937 state refreshes (624 outputs each).\n// The twist of one refresh is split into three dependency-free phases.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(MT_GEN_THREADS)\nmtGenerateKernel(uint32_t* __restrict__ state, float* __restrict__ out, uint32_t numGens) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t s[2][MT_N];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (int k = tid; k < MT_N; k += blockDim.x) s[0][k] = state[k];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int cur = 0;\n    for (uint32_t g = 0; g < numGens; ++g) {\n        const uint32_t* O = s[cur];\n        uint32_t* N = s[cur ^ 1];\n        float* o = out + static_cast<size_t>(g) * MT_N;\n\n        if (tid < MT_NM) {\n            int k = tid;\n            uint32_t v = mtTwist(O[k], O[k + 1], O[k + MT_M]);\n            N[k] = v;\n            o[k] = mtTemperToFloat(v);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid < MT_NM) {\n            int k = tid + MT_NM;\n            uint32_t v = mtTwist(O[k], O[k + 1], N[k - MT_NM]);\n            N[k] = v;\n            o[k] = mtTemperToFloat(v);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid < MT_N - 2 * MT_NM) {\n            int k = tid + 2 * MT_NM;\n            uint32_t next = (k == MT_N - 1) ? N[0] : O[k + 1];\n            uint32_t v = mtTwist(O[k], next, N[k - MT_NM]);\n            N[k] = v;\n            o[k] = mtTemperToFloat(v);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        cur ^= 1;\n    }\n    for (int k = tid; k < MT_N; k += blockDim.x) state[k] = s[cur][k];\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device geometry\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DevTri {\n    float4 v0;   // a.xyz\n    float4 e1;   // (b - a).xyz\n    float4 e2;   // (c - a).xyz\n};\n\nstruct DevNode {\n    float cx, cy, cz;\n    float hx, hy, hz;\n    int childStart, childCount;\n    int triStart, triCount;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 f3sub(float3 a, float3 b) { return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z); }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float f3dot(float3 a, float3 b) { return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z; }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 f3cross(float3 a, float3 b) {\n    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);\n}\n\n// Same-direction culling test, with the exact operation order of the host build\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool culledPair(float3 nI, float3 nJ) {\n    float d = __fmaf_rn(nI.z, nJ.z, __fmaf_rn(nI.x, nJ.x, __fmul_rn(nI.y, nJ.y)));\n    return d > 0.99f;\n}\n\n// Tau computation with the exact operation order of the host build\n__device__ __forceinline__ int tauFromCenters(float3 ci, float3 cj) {\n    float dx = __fsub_rn(ci.x, cj.x);\n    float dy = __fsub_rn(ci.y, cj.y);\n    float dz = __fsub_rn(ci.z, cj.z);\n    float sq = __fmaf_rn(dz, dz, __fmaf_rn(dx, dx, __fmul_rn(dy, dy)));\n    float dist = __fsqrt_rn(sq);\n    return static_cast<int>(ceilf(__fmul_rn(dist, INV_WAVE_SPEED)));\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriDev(float3 orig, float3 dir, const DevTri& t) {\n    const float BIG = 3.402823466e+38f;\n    float3 v0 = make_float3(t.v0.x, t.v0.y, t.v0.z);\n    float3 e1 = make_float3(t.e1.x, t.e1.y, t.e1.z);\n    float3 e2 = make_float3(t.e2.x, t.e2.y, t.e2.z);\n    float3 pvec = f3cross(dir, e2);\n    float det = f3dot(e1, pvec);\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return BIG;\n    float invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    float3 tvec = f3sub(orig, v0);\n    float u = f3dot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return BIG;\n    float3 qvec = f3cross(tvec, e1);\n    float v = f3dot(dir, qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return BIG;\n    return f3dot(e2, qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayBoxDev(const DevNode& nd, float3 p1, float3 d, float3 ad) {\n    float3 c = make_float3(p1.x + d.x - nd.cx, p1.y + d.y - nd.cy, p1.z + d.z - nd.cz);\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > nd.hx + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > nd.hy + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > nd.hz + ad.z) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > nd.hy * ad.z + nd.hz * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > nd.hz * ad.x + nd.hx * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > nd.hx * ad.y + nd.hy * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n    return true;\n}\n\nconstexpr int TRAVERSAL_STACK = 128;\n\n// Octree-accelerated visibility test (the result is order independent)\n__device__ bool isRayBlockedDev(float3 from, float3 to, const DevNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                const int* __restrict__ childList, const int* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                                const DevTri* __restrict__ tris, int src, int dst) {\n    float3 dir = f3sub(to, from);\n    float rayLen = sqrtf(f3dot(dir, dir));\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    float3 dirN = make_float3(dir.x / rayLen, dir.y / rayLen, dir.z / rayLen);\n    float3 d = make_float3(dir.x * 0.5f, dir.y * 0.5f, dir.z * 0.5f);\n    float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));\n    float limit = rayLen - EPSILON;\n\n    int stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root is visited without a box test\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const DevNode nd = nodes[--sp >= 0 ? stack[sp] : 0];\n        if (nd.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < nd.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = __ldg(&leafTris[nd.triStart + k]);\n                if (idx == src || idx == dst) continue;\n                float dist = rayTriDev(from, dirN, tris[idx]);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < limit) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int k = 0; k < nd.childCount; ++k) {\n                int ch = __ldg(&childList[nd.childStart + k]);\n                if (rayBoxDev(nodes[ch], from, d, ad)) stack[sp++] = ch;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 pointInTri(const DevTri& t, float u, float v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    return make_float3(t.v0.x + t.e1.x * u + t.e2.x * v,\n                       t.v0.y + t.e1.y * u + t.e2.y * v,\n                       t.v0.z + t.e1.z * u + t.e2.z * v);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernels: pair enumeration, form factors, time delays\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One warp per (row i, block of 32 columns): number of non-culled pairs\n__global__ void countPairsKernel(const float3* __restrict__ normals, int n, int nb,\n                                 unsigned long long numTasks, unsigned long long* __restrict__ counts) {\n    unsigned long long w = (static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) >> 5;\n    int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (w >= numTasks) return;\n    int i = static_cast<int>(w / nb);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(w % nb) * 32 + lane;\n    bool valid = j < n && j != i && !culledPair(normals[i], normals[j]);\n    unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, valid);\n    if (lane == 0) counts[w] = __popc(mask);\n}\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(128)\nformFactorKernel(const DevTri* __restrict__ tris, const float3* __restrict__ normals,\n                 const DevNode* __restrict__ nodes, const int* __restrict__ childList,\n                 const int* __restrict__ leafTris, int n, int nb,\n                 unsigned long long w0, unsigned long long numTasks,\n                 const unsigned long long* __restrict__ excl,\n                 unsigned long long p0, unsigned long long p1,\n                 const float* __restrict__ rnd, float* __restrict__ kij) {\n    unsigned long long wl = (static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) >> 5;\n    int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (wl >= numTasks) return;\n    unsigned long long w = w0 + wl;\n    int i = static_cast<int>(w / nb);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(w % nb) * 32 + lane;\n    float3 nI = normals[i];\n    bool valid = j < n && j != i && !culledPair(nI, normals[j]);\n    unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, valid);\n    if (!valid) return;\n    unsigned long long p = excl[w] + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u));\n    if (p < p0 || p >= p1) return;\n\n    const DevTri tI = tris[i];\n    const DevTri tJ = tris[j];\n    float3 nJ = normals[j];\n    const float4* r4 = reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(rnd + (p - p0) * RANDS_PER_PAIR);\n\n    float acc = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        float4 q = __ldg(&r4[r]);\n        float3 pI = pointInTri(tI, q.x, q.y);\n        float3 pJ = pointInTri(tJ, q.z, q.w);\n\n        if (isRayBlockedDev(pI, pJ, nodes, childList, leafTris, tris, i, j)) continue;\n\n        float3 v = f3sub(pJ, pI);\n        float distSqr = f3dot(v, v);\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n        float vNorm = sqrtf(distSqr);\n        if (vNorm <= EPSILON) continue;\n        float cI = fmaxf(ZERO, f3dot(v, nI) / vNorm);\n        float cJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -f3dot(v, nJ) / vNorm);\n        if (cI <= ZERO || cJ <= ZERO) continue;\n        acc += (cI * cJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n    kij[static_cast<size_t>(i) * n + j] = acc * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// Builds the transposed (column-major) coupling weights used by the simulation:\n// wT[j][i] = min(kij[i][j] * area[j], 1) (or 0 if kij <= 0), tauT[j][i] = tau(i, j)\nconstexpr int TILE = 32;\n__global__ void couplingKernel(const float* __restrict__ kij, const float* __restrict__ areas,\n                               const float3* __restrict__ centers, int n,\n                               float* __restrict__ wT, unsigned char* __restrict__ tauT) {\n    __shared__ float tile[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    int bi = blockIdx.y * TILE;   // row block (i)\n    int bj = blockIdx.x * TILE;   // column block (j)\n    int tx = threadIdx.x, ty = threadIdx.y;   // 32 x 8\n    for (int r = ty; r < TILE; r += blockDim.y) {\n        int i = bi + r, j = bj + tx;\n        tile[r][tx] = (i < n && j < n) ? kij[static_cast<size_t>(i) * n + j] : ZERO;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int r = ty; r < TILE; r += blockDim.y) {\n        int j = bj + r, i = bi + tx;\n        if (i < n && j < n) {\n            float k = tile[tx][r];\n            float w = (i != j && k > ZERO) ? fminf(__fmul_rn(k, areas[j]), ONE) : ZERO;\n            int tau = (i != j) ? tauFromCenters(centers[i], centers[j]) : 0;\n            size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i;\n            wT[o] = w;\n            tauT[o] = static_cast<unsigned char>(tau);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void tauKernel(const float3* __restrict__ centers, int n, int* __restrict__ tau) {\n    size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (idx >= static_cast<size_t>(n) * n) return;\n    int i = static_cast<int>(idx / n), j = static_cast<int>(idx % n);\n    tau[idx] = (i != j) ? tauFromCenters(centers[i], centers[j]) : 0;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernels: wave propagation and cross-correlation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per receiving triangle; sequential sum over j in the original order\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(64)\nsimulationStepKernel(const float* __restrict__ wT, const unsigned char* __restrict__ tauT,\n                     const float* __restrict__ rho, const float* __restrict__ radE,\n                     float* __restrict__ radB, int n, int t) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n    float sumB = ZERO;\n    const float* wcol = wT + i;\n    const unsigned char* tcol = tauT + i;\n#pragma unroll 8\n    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(j) * n;\n        int tauij = tcol[o];\n        float w = wcol[o];\n __fmul_rn(w, radJ));\n    }\n    size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i;\n    radB[o] = __fmaf_rn(rho[i], sumB, radE[o]);\n}\n\n__global__ void distanceKernel(const float* __restrict__ radB, int n, int T, int src,\n                               float* __restrict__ distances) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n    float maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        float sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            float pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * n + i];\n            float pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * n + src];\n            sum = __fadd_rn(sum, __fmul_rn(pS, pB));\n        }\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t std::vector<DevNode>& nodes,\n                          std::vector<int>& childList, std::vector<int>& leafTris) {\n    std::vector<const Octree*> order;\n    order.push_back(&root);\n    nodes.clear();\n    childList.clear();\n    leafTris.clear();\n    for (size_t q = 0; q < order.size(); ++q) {\n        const Octree* o = order[q];\n        DevNode nd;\n        nd.cx = o->center.x; nd.childCount = 0;\n        nd.triStart = static_cast<int>(leafTris.size());\n        nd.triCount = static_cast<int>(o->triangleIndices.size());\n        for (size_t idx : o->triangleIndices) childList.push_back(static_cast<int>(order.size()));\n                    order.push_back(o->children[c].get());\n                    nd.childCount++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        nodes.push_back(nd);\n    }\n}\n\nstatic int octreeDepth(const Octree& o) {\n    int d = 0;\n    if (o.triangleIndices.empty()) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c)\n            if (o.children[c]) d = std::max(d, octreeDepth(*o.children[c]));\n    }\n    return d + 1;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nstatic T* deviceUpload(const std::vector<T>& v) {\n    T* p = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&p, std::max<size_t>(1, v.size()) * sizeof(T)));\n    if (!v.empty()) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(p, v.data(), v.size() * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    return p;\n}\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; deviceUpload(leafTris);\n    state.dAreas = deviceUpload(state.areas);\n    state.dRho = deviceUpload(state.rho);\n    state.dRadE = deviceUpload(state.radE);\n    state.dRadB = n * n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// char)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dc.dDistances, n * sizeof(float)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dc.dKij, 0, std::max<size_t>(1, nloc * n) * sizeof(float)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int nb = (n + 31) / 32;\n    const unsigned long long numTasks = static_cast<unsigned long long>(n) * nb;\n    const int numGpus = static_cast<int>(state.devs.size());\n\n    // Random stream layout: the sequence is split into segments of MT_SEG_GENS\n    // generator refreshes; a chunk of work covers CHUNK_SEGS segments (plus one\n    // for a non-aligned start). Segment start states are obtained by exact\n    // jump-ahead, so all segments of a chunk are generated in parallel.\n    constexpr int CHUNK_LOG2_SEGS = 5;\n    constexpr unsigned long long CHUNK_SEGS = 1ull << CHUNK_LOG2_SEGS;\n    constexpr unsigned long long PAIRS_PER_CHUNK = CHUNK_SEGS * PAIRS_PER_SEG;\n    const int jumpSmem = MT_JUMP_SEQ * sizeof(uint32_t);\n\n    struct Work {\n        unsigned long long* dCounts = nullptr;\n        unsigned long long* dExcl = nullptr;\n        uint32_t* dMasks = nullptr;\n        void* dScanTmp = nullptr;\n        unsigned long long p0 = 0, p1 = 0;   // pair range of the GPU's rows\n        unsigned long long seg0 = 0;         // segment containing the first pair\n        unsigned long long segOff = 0;       // word offset of the first pair in it\n        unsigned long long numChunks = 0;\n        std::vector<uint16_t*> dJumpBits;\n        uint32_t* dMtCur = nullptr;\n        uint32_t* dMtStates[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n        float* dRnd[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n        cudaEvent_t genDone[2], compDone[2];\n    };\n    std::vector<Work> work(numGpus);\n\n    // 1. Enumerate non-culled pairs (on every GPU): each consumes exactly\n    //    RANDS_PER_PAIR random numbers of the sequential stream, in (i, j)\n    //    row-major order.\n    for (int g = 0; g < numGpus; ++g) {\n        DeviceContext& dc = state.devs[g];\n        Work& wk = work[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(dc.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&wk.dCounts, (numTasks + 1) * sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&wk.dExcl, (numTasks + 1) * sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&wk.dMasks, numTasks * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(wk.dCounts + numTasks, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long), dc.sComp));\n        const int threads = 256;\n        unsigned long long blocks = (numTasks * 32 + threads - 1) / threads;\n        countPairsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(blocks), threads, 0, dc.sComp>>>(\n            dc.dNormals, n, nb, numTasks, wk.dCounts, wk.dMasks);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        size_t tmpBytes = 0;\n        cub::DeviceScan::ExclusiveSum(nullptr, tmpBytes, wk.dCounts, wk.dExcl, numTasks + 1, dc.sComp);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&wk.dScanTmp, tmpBytes));\n        cub::DeviceScan::ExclusiveSum(wk.dScanTmp, tmpBytes, wk.dCounts, wk.dExcl, numTasks + 1, dc.sComp);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    unsigned long long totalPairs = 0;\n    for (int g = 0; g < numGpus; ++g) {\n        DeviceContext& dc = state.devs[g];\n        Work& wk = work[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(dc.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&wk.p0, wk.dExcl + static_cast<size_t>(dc.r0) * nb,\n                                   sizeof(unsigned long long), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, dc.sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&wk.p1, wk.dExcl + static_cast<size_t>(dc.r1) * nb,\n                                   sizeof(unsigned long long), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, dc.sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(dc.sComp));\n        totalPairs = std::max(totalPairs, wk.p1);\n        wk.seg0 = wk.p0 * RANDS_PER_PAIR / MT_SEG_WORDS;\n        wk.segOff = wk.p0 * RANDS_PER_PAIR % MT_SEG_WORDS;\n        wk.numChunks = (wk.p1 - wk.p0 + PAIRS_PER_CHUNK - 1) / PAIRS_PER_CHUNK;\n    }\n\n    // 2. Per-GPU generator setup: start state of the GPU's first segment\n    for (int g = 0; g < numGpus; ++g) {\n        DeviceContext& dc = state.devs[g];\n        Work& wk = work[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(dc.device));\n        for (auto& bits : jumpPolys) wk.dJumpBits.push_back(deviceUpload(bits));\n        const unsigned long long bufSegs = std::min(CHUNK_SEGS + 1, std::max(1ull, totalSegs));\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&wk.dMtStates[b], bufSegs * MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&wk.dRnd[b], bufSegs * MT_SEG_WORDS * sizeof(float)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&wk.genDone[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&wk.compDone[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(mtJumpKernel, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, jumpSmem));\n        uint32_t st[MT_N];\n        mtSeedState(42u, st);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&wk.dMtCur, sizeof(st)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(wk.dMtCur, st, sizeof(st), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        for (int t = 0; t <= levels; ++t)\n            if ((wk.seg0 >> t) & 1ull) launchJump(g, wk.dMtCur, wk.dMtCur, 1, t);\n    }\n\n    // 4. Every pair of triangles that isn't culled uses exactly 64 random numbers, so a prefix sum gives each pair's position in the stream. The GPU then reproduces that exact stream in parallel, using an exact jump-ahead to start each segment of the stream independently.\n- **Form factors.** One thread per ray. The 32 rays in a warp walk the octree together, but each ray still tests exactly the nodes and triangles it tested in the original. These GPUs can't talk to each other directly, so each timestep's results are exchanged through pinned host memory.\n\n**Things you should know:**\n- **Wall-clock time vs printed time.** On this machine, starting CUDA with 4 GPUs visible takes about 1.8 s, plus about 170 ms per GPU used. That's why multi-GPU only kicks in at 5120 triangles. At that size, total program runtime is about 3.8 s with 4 GPUs versus about 1.5 s when only one GPU is visible (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0`), even though the printed time is lower with 4. If your harness measures wall-clock time, one GPU is faster at 5120; for 20480 and up, 4 GPUs should win either way.\n- **Exactness depends on the toolchain.** Bit-identical results rely on matching how the original GNU build rounds floating-point maths. I pass `-ffp-contract=fast` for host code and use explicit rounding intrinsics in the few GPU spots that decide culling, delays and summation order. A different compiler or libstdc++ could in principle change this.\n- **Hard-coded generator constant.** The source now contains the 135 exponents of `mt19937`'s characteristic polynomial, which the jump-ahead needs. I derived them at runtime, and the program re-checks them against the generator on every run.\n- **CMake.** It now requires CMake 3.18.
